description: Exhaustive provenance audit of all 65 hybrid split configurations and 4,664 hybrid split proposals to attribute contributions from Strategies A through E.

Strategy_A_WallNetwork.architectural_role: Provides clean axis-aligned wall cuts separating rooms bounded by internal walls.

Strategy_B_PlanarFace.root_cause: Strategy B searches for wall_network_face proposals strictly contained within cavities. Existing WallNetwork faces either already define entire rooms or fail strict 0.70 containment + <0.85 area ratio bounds. Removing Strategy B changes 0 proposals and 0 configurations.

Strategy_C_PartitionSplit.architectural_role: Projects internal partition rays perpendicular to wall lines to create room subdivisions.

Strategy_D_DoorwayTopology.root_cause: Requires at least 2 detected doorways located within 20px of cavity boundary with Euclidean distance >= 50px whose perpendicular bisecting cut produces >= 2 valid polygons satisfying min_area >= 350px. Across all 88 cavities in the benchmark, zero cavities met all topological closure conditions simultaneously. Removing Strategy D changes 0 proposals and 0 configurations.

Strategy_E_ProposalGuided.architectural_role: Clips Phase 2.10.4 proposals to cavity boundaries, generating dense local candidate seeds for open-plan room recovery.
